source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 196 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-196.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 196 was established by Ordinance No. 18631, passed by the Dallas City Council on March 13, 1985. Ordinance No. 18631 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 18631 was amended by Ordinance No. 19560, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 20, 1987. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18631; 19560; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-196.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 196 is established on property generally located at the east corner of Travis Avenue and Armstrong Avenue. The size of PD 196 is approximately 54,000 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 18631; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-196.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-196.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. Development and utilization of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 196A) and ground level plan (Exhibit 196B). (Ord. Nos. 18631; 25508)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-196.105.LANDSCAPE PLAN. The Property must be landscaped in accordance with the landscape plan (Exhibit 196C). The maintenance of all landscaping is the responsibility of the property owner. (Ord. Nos. 18631; 25508)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-196.106.USES. The only uses permitted on the Property are as follows:
(1)Those retail uses defined in Section 51-4.211.
(2)Bank or savings and loan office (without drive-in windows).
(3)Barber and beauty shop.
(4)Duplication shop.
(5)Handcrafted art work studio.
(6)Health studio.
(7)Instructional arts studio.
(8)Key shop.
(9)Laundry or cleaning pick-up and receiving station.
(10)Office.
(11)Photography studio.
(12)Restaurant with alcoholic beverages and/or entertainment.
(13)Shoe repair.
(14)Tailor, custom sewing, and millinery.
(15)Travel bureau.
(16)Theater. (Ord. Nos. 19560; 25508)

sections.title: Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-196.107.HEIGHT. Maximum permitted height for all structures is 58 feet. In this article, height means the distance from grade to the highest point of a structure. (Ord. Nos. 18631; 25508)

sections.title: Coverage
sections.text: SEC. 51P-196.108.COVERAGE. Maximum permitted coverage on the Property is 34,000 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 18631; 25508)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-196.109.PARKING. Parking must be provided in accordance with the provisions of the Oak Lawn Special Purpose District, Article 51P-193. (Ord. Nos. 19560; 25508)

sections.title: Maximum Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-196.110.MAXIMUM FLOOR AREA. For purposes of this article, the floor area of a structure used for off-street parking or a basement is excluded in computing maximum permitted floor area. Maximum permitted floor area for each use is as follows, but in no event may the total floor area for all uses combined exceed 105,000 square feet:
(1)All office uses combined - 50,000 square feet.
(2)All restaurant uses combined - 22,337 square feet.
(3)All other uses combined - 29,707 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 19560; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-196.111.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.
(a)Utilization of the Property must comply with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.
(c)The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18631; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-196.112.ZONING MAP. PD 196 is located on Zoning Map No. H-7. (Ord Nos. 18631; 25508)
